## PR Title Convention

Please ensure your PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/):
`type(scope): short description`

- **Types**: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `build`, `ci`, `chore`, `revert`
- **Scopes**: `quizms`, `mdx`, `firebase`, `training`, `rest`, `docs`, `ci`, `deps`
- *Example*: `fix(mdx): prevent crash on empty blockly container`

## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation has been updated (or is not required).
